title: Upgrade Leave Application Generator to Semi-Smart Guided Application with Calendar, Dropdowns, and Live Preview

requirements.text: Replace the manual Leave Date / Period text input with a calendar date picker component that supports both single date selection (one-day leave) and date range selection (multiple days leave). Automatically format the selected dates into a proper leave duration string in the generated application letter.

quotes: Replace the manual Leave Date / Period text input with a smart Calendar Date Picker

acceptanceCriteria: Date picker allows selecting a single date for one-day leave
Date picker allows selecting a date range for multiple-day leave
Selected dates are automatically formatted into a proper leave duration in the generated letter

requirements.text: Add a Reason for Leave dropdown menu with predefined options: Sick Leave, Family Function, Personal Work, Emergency, and Other (Custom Input). When a predefined reason is selected, automatically generate a professional sentence related to that reason in the leave application letter. When 'Other' is selected, display a text input field allowing the user to manually type their custom reason.

quotes: Add a Reason for Leave dropdown menu with the following options

acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown includes all five specified options: Sick Leave, Family Function, Personal Work, Emergency, Other
Each predefined reason generates an appropriate professional sentence in the letter
Selecting 'Other' reveals a custom text input field
Custom reason text is inserted into the generated letter when provided

requirements.text: Add two new required input fields: School / College Name and Class / Grade. Automatically insert these details into the correct position in the generated leave application letter format.

quotes: Add two new required input fields: School / College Name, Class / Grade

acceptanceCriteria: School/College Name field is present and marked as required
Class/Grade field is present and marked as required
Both fields are inserted into the appropriate positions in the generated letter

requirements.text: Implement a Live Preview Panel positioned on the right side of the form that displays the generated leave application letter. Update the preview in real-time as the user fills in or updates any field (Name, Date, Reason, School, Class) without requiring a Generate button click.

quotes: Implement a Live Preview Panel on the right side of the form

acceptanceCriteria: Preview panel is positioned on the right side of the form
Letter preview updates instantly whenever any form field changes
No Generate button is required to update the preview
All form fields (Name, Date, Reason, School, Class) are reflected in the live preview

requirements.text: Add a Copy to Clipboard button below the generated letter preview that copies the full application text to the user's clipboard. Add a Download as PDF button that downloads the generated leave application as a ready-to-print PDF file.

quotes: Add two action buttons below the generated letter preview: Copy to Clipboard, Download as PDF

acceptanceCriteria: Copy to Clipboard button successfully copies the full letter text
Download as PDF button generates and downloads a PDF file
Both buttons are positioned below the letter preview
PDF is formatted appropriately for printing

requirements.text: Ensure the upgraded Leave Application Generator maintains a mobile-responsive design that remains clean, simple, and student-friendly. The live preview panel should adapt appropriately on smaller screens.

quotes: Ensure the overall design remains mobile responsive, clean, and easy to use

acceptanceCriteria: Layout is fully responsive on mobile, tablet, and desktop screens
Form and preview panel adapt appropriately for different screen sizes
UI remains clean and easy to use for students
No unnecessary complexity is added to the interface

constraints: Only modify the Leave Application Generator page (frontend/src/pages/LeaveApplicationPage.tsx)
Do not add advanced AI features or unnecessary complexity
Maintain the existing clean and student-friendly aesthetic
Keep the design consistent with the existing StudentSathi application style
